image_description: A close-up shot of a mature male orangutan with long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and prominent cheek pads. The subject is positioned behind a large, textured grey rock in the foreground, which obscures the lower body and hands. The background consists of a rough, grey stone wall. The orangutan's face is clearly visible, showing dark eyes and a broad nose.
